name: Mohamed Naguib
contribution: An Egyptian military officer and revolutionary who was the principal leader of the Free Officers movement of 1952 that toppled the monarchy of Egypt and the Sudan, leading to the establishment of the Republic of Egypt.

checks.lead: Mohamed Naguib Youssef Qutb El-Qashlan (Arabic: محمد نجيب يوسف قطب القشلان; 19 February 1901 – 28 August 1984), known simply as Mohamed Naguib (Arabic: محمد نجيب), was an Egyptian military officer and revolutionary who was the principal leader of the Free Officers movement of 1952 that toppled the monarchy of Egypt and the Sudan, leading to the establishment of the Republic of Egypt. He was the first President of Egypt.
